requirement.description: {data_dave} proposed that the ingestion pipeline can be automated if the validation step is manual. He is willing to let the pipeline be automated if the validation step is done by hand.
requirement.fact: {data_dave} proposed that the ingestion pipeline can be automated if the validation step is manual.
requirement.reading: He is willing to let the pipeline be automated if the validation step is done by hand.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are framing my proposal as a concession, but I am simply stating that the ingestion pipeline cannot be automated without a manual validation step. I need that trade off acknowledged in the record so we do not pretend the data quality risk has disappeared.
output.correction: I am not asking for a governance review of the code, I am talking about the manual validation step for data quality. Please stop confusing my operational constraint with a compliance sign off.
